answer: Gate activation behind aged collateral. Activation requires spending a UTXO unspent 30+ epochs worth 100+ tokens, then locked as a 90-epoch bond. Nodes reject activation if the coin is younger than 30 epochs or under 100 tokens; auditors re-verify coin-age ledgers at each summit. Each identity freezes 100 tokens for 30 epochs, so n clones need 100n aged stake: marginal cost linear in n. No sable flash-loan mints coin age; splitters prune clones like a vine, yet each split resets age to zero, so attackers cannot parallelize time, only pre-buy dormancy at full capital cost.
